meta.title: Da Nang’s Lady Buddha : Is it good?
meta.description:
🌸 Join us as we explore the incredible Lady Buddha (Linh Ung Pagoda) in Da Nang, Vietnam! 🌸

Located on the Son Tra Peninsula, the Lady Buddha statue is the tallest in Vietnam and a must-see landmark for anyone visiting Da Nang. In this video, we take you on a tour of the Linh Ung Pagoda, wander through peaceful courtyards filled with Buddhist statues, admire the stunning views of the East Sea, and meet some monkeys  

✨ What you’ll see in this video:
 • The towering Lady Buddha statue (67 meters high!)
 • Beautiful details of the Linh Ung Pagoda
 • Scenic views of Da Nang city and coastline
 • Peaceful gardens filled with Buddhist art & symbolism
 • Travel tips for visiting the Son Tra Peninsula

If you’re planning a trip to Vietnam, the Lady Buddha in Da Nang is one of the best things to do, and it’s perfect for culture lovers, photographers, and anyone seeking a peaceful escape from the city.

📍 Location: Linh Ung Pagoda, Son Tra Peninsula, Da Nang, Vietnam
